gdacs-cyclone-tc-1001343.summary: Typhoon In-fa (JMA No. 31) brought high waves and strong winds to the Ogasawara Islands in Tokyo, Japan, around 4 to 5 November 2026. A peak gust of 25.4 m/s was recorded at Chichijima on 5 November. At 09:00 JST on 6 November 2026, it became an extratropical low east of Japan. No deaths, damage or evacuations were reported in the sources found.

The research was incomplete: no official, news or agency sources were checked.

ifrc-flood-8050.summary: Monsoon flooding in Myanmar in 2026 affected several regions, including Sagaing, Ayeyarwady, Rakhine, Kachin and Tanintharyi. Flooding and landslides hit Dawei District in late September and early October after record rainfall. The latest report found is dated 5 October 2026; the notes do not say whether flooding continued into November.
